summary: The Trump administration is challenging D.C.'s tuition policies for undocumented immigrants while advocates continue highlighting federal interference in District affairs, from National Guard deployments to fiscal constraints. Meanwhile, a senator has pledged to prioritize D.C. statehood, and advocates are urging Congress to protect D.C.'s limited financial independence from further federal restrictions. Without statehood, Congress can override any law the District passes and can restrict how D.C. spends its own local tax revenue.
